1. Breadcrumbs, one row (#vi-crumbs-place).

**Right pane: chat.** The transcript, then the composer with the open-card chip, then the conversation tab strip at the bottom (#werk-mc-tabs). The pane itself is #werk-pane.

The width of the left pane, not the window, decides how views adapt. Rules for a narrow pane live on the cards of each view.
